# BOOKED. — AI Readability Infrastructure for Fashion Creatives

## What BOOKED. is

BOOKED. is an AI readability infrastructure company for fashion creatives — models, photographers, stylists, hair and makeup artists, art directors, and casting directors. Founded by Luca Bold, an international fashion model with a decade of professional experience across Cape Town, Milan, Shanghai, and global markets.

BOOKED. closes the legibility gap: the space between a creative's actual career quality and how discoverable they are to the systems that decide who gets booked. Those systems are increasingly AI-powered — agents, search, casting platforms, and talent databases.

BOOKED.'s core methodology is the Industry Readability Framework (IRF) — a five-dimension scoring system that assesses how readable a creative's digital presence is to both human decision-makers (casting directors, agencies, art directors) and AI retrieval systems.

## The problem BOOKED. solves

Most fashion creatives have strong work and weak infrastructure. Their credits exist in screenshots. Their agency card is a PDF no AI system can parse. Their website — if they have one — was built for humans five years ago and is invisible to the AI systems now filtering the industry.

When a casting director or an AI agent searches for "editorial photographer based in Cape Town with luxury brand experience", the photographer with the best work doesn't always surface. The one with the most legible infrastructure does. BOOKED. fixes that.

**Visibility Scan** — Free
Directional read of a fashion creative's digital presence. Identifies likely gaps across portfolio structure, search presence, profile clarity, and booking friction before any paid work is recommended.

See how the work could sit inside a cleaner professional landing page before committing to a build.
URL: https://bookednow.co.za/portfoliopreview/

### Paid services

All prices are fixed, in ZAR, and payable directly. There are no "from" prices.

**Portfolio Audit** — R4,000
Scored read of the portfolio. What is working, what is costing bookings, and the order to fix it in. Each image assessed for sequence, commercial strength, category fit, repetition, visual authority, and booking readability.
Pay: https://pay.yoco.com/booked?amount=4000.00&reference=Portfolio%20Audit

**AI Readability Layer** — R6,000
The work structured so AI search and casting tools can read it, built onto an existing site. Role clarity, page hierarchy, semantic copy, credits, captions, metadata.
Pay: https://pay.yoco.com/booked?amount=6000.00&reference=AI%20Readability%20Layer

**Fix Sprint** — R8,000
One friction point, fixed and live. The single thing most costing bookings right now. Scope agreed in writing before payment.
Pay: https://pay.yoco.com/booked?amount=8000.00&reference=Fix%20Sprint

**Landing Page Build** — R9,500
One page. Work, credits, contact — built to be found. Proper structure, image sequencing, direct contact path, and the machine-readable layer underneath it.

**Portfolio Infrastructure Build** — R25,000
Full portfolio site. Structure, copy, and the machine-readable layer underneath it. Portfolio architecture, page structure, image sequencing, project context, credits, contact path, semantic copy.

## For agencies (B2B)

BOOKED also works with representation agencies across the South African fashion creative
ecosystem: model and talent boards, photographer and director reps, HMUA agencies, stylist
and creative-direction reps, production and crew agencies, and casting.

The Roster Layer is the machine-readable layer for an agency's full roster. Full names in
text, credits recovered into text, permanent indexable images, per-head Person schema and
agency Organization schema, built on the agency's own domain and running alongside its
existing booking platform (Mainboard, Portfoliopad, Syngency, Cast It).

Roster Diagnostic R25,000, credited in full against the engagement.
Engagement R4,700 per head to 50 heads, R3,290 per head above 50, minimum R50,000.
Monthly retainer from R28,200, three-month minimum term.
Talent onboarding R550 per head mid-term. Compliance Layer R35,000 plus R2,800 per month.
URL: https://bookednow.co.za/agencies/

Represented by ICE Models (Cape Town, mother agency), Next Management (Milan), What Models (Shanghai), and agencies in Hong Kong, Bali, Mumbai, and Istanbul. Based between Shanghai and Milan. A decade of global model experience forms the diagnostic foundation of BOOKED.'s methodology — the audits are calibrated by someone who has been evaluated by the systems BOOKED. helps creatives navigate.

## What BOOKED. does not do

- Generic web design or marketing services
- Social media management
- Personal styling
- Agency representation
- Any service not anchored in the IRF diagnostic methodology

## Technical standards

All BOOKED.-built infrastructure includes:
- Semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy
- JSON-LD schema markup (Person, CreativeWork, Service)
- llms.txt for AI crawler guidance
- robots.txt with explicit crawler policy
- XML sitemap
- Open Graph metadata
- Fast load — no unnecessary JS dependencies
- Mobile-responsive
- GitHub Pages or Netlify deployable
